mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID, STATUS FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, REASON_TYPE, DETAIL, SPECIAL_YN, SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, SETTLEMENT_MEMO, SETTLEMENT_BY, SETTLEMENT_AT, STATUS, RECONFIRM_COUNT FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST WHERE WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = #{withdrawalRequestId}

SELECT WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, REASON_TYPE, DETAIL, SPECIAL_YN, SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, SETTLEMENT_MEMO, SETTLEMENT_BY, SETTLEMENT_AT, STATUS, RECONFIRM_COUNT FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = #{withdrawalRequestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST ( WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, REASON_TYPE, DETAIL, SPECIAL_YN, STATUS, RECONFIRM_COUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{reasonType}, #{detail}, #{specialYn}, 'SETTLEMENT_PENDING', 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CONSENT c USING DUAL ON (c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'SETTLEMENT' AND c.TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c.AGREED_YN = #{agreedYn}, c.AGREED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CONSENT_ID, CONSENT_TYPE, TARGET_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, AGREED_YN, AGREED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_CONSENT.NEXTVAL, 'SETTLEMENT', #{targetId}, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{agreedYn}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT wct.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS memberName, gm.STATUS AS memberStatus, wct.STATUS AS status, wct.RESPONDED_AT AS respondedAt, wct.EXEMPTED_BY AS exemptedBy, wct.EXEMPTED_AT AS exemptedAt, wct.EXEMPTION_REASON AS exemptionReason FROM WITHDRAWAL_CONSENT_TARGET wct JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = wct.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID WHERE wct.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND wct.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = #{withdrawalRequestId} ORDER BY wct.MEMBER_ID

SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID FROM WITHDRAWAL_CONSENT_TARGET wct JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = wct.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE wct.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND wct.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = #{withdrawalRequestId} FOR UPDATE OF gm.STATUS

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_CONSENT_TARGET wct JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = wct.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE wct.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND wct.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = #{withdrawalRequestId} AND wct.STATUS NOT IN ('AGREED', 'EXEMPT')

SELECT wr.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID AS withdrawalRequestId, wr.GROUP_ID AS groupId, wr.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS memberName, wr.REASON_TYPE AS reasonType, wr.DETAIL AS detail, wr.SPECIAL_YN AS specialYn, wr.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT AS settlementAmount, wr.SETTLEMENT_MEMO AS settlementMemo, wr.SETTLEMENT_BY AS settlementBy, wr.SETTLEMENT_AT AS settlementAt, wr.STATUS AS status, wr.RECONFIRM_COUNT AS reconfirmCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_CONSENT_TARGET wct JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = wct.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE wct.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = wr.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID AND wct.STATUS = 'AGREED') AS agreedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_CONSENT_TARGET wct JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = wct.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE wct.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = wr.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID AND wct.STATUS = 'EXEMPT') AS exemptedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_CONSENT_TARGET wct JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = wct.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = wct.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE wct.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID = wr.WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_ID) AS targetCount, wr.DECIDED_AT AS decidedAt, wr.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST wr JOIN MEMBER m ON wr.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE wr.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} ORDER BY wr.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, NOTIF_TYPE, TITLE, BODY, LINK_PAGE, REF_ID, READ_YN, DELETED_YN, SMS_SENT_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{notifType}, #{title}, #{body}, #{linkPage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'N', 'N', 'N', SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{targetMemberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{adminId}, #{targetMemberId}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
